traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 genus aggregate for Taxus (gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv, read): specific gravity 0.55 (wsg_est, the hierarchical-model genus mean, from 21 records in 11 sources); trunks 0.55, branches 0.57. A species with its own measurements states its own. Basic density is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

traits.reproduction.note: OregonFlora's account of the genus, after the Flora of North America: a yew's seed sits alone in a soft, thick, scarlet to orange-scarlet aril, a cup open at its tip that leaves the hard seed coat showing.
